tei:div.tei:p: dhī: dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi'i sngags kyi srung ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so: : 12345ཿ he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: bdud rtsi gsang ba'i srung ma che: e ka dzā ṭī'i sgrub thabs ni: dur khrod la sogs drag po'i sar: sku rten dar nag phyag rgyas mtshan: gsung rten sngags kyi byang bus brgyan: thugs kyi rten du nal bu'i snying : 'khor lo'i srog dang ldan par 'phyang : de la 'khor lo 'di yin te: ro ras khrag gis sbags pa la: rtsibs bzhi mu khyud ldan pa'i dbus: bh+yo mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: rtsibs bzhir shar nas rim pa bzhin: kā ya ma ma hūm̐ bh+yo badz+ra sa ma ya staṃ: gu ṇa ma ma hūm̐ bh+yo badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: wā ka ma ma hūm̐ bh+yo badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: kwarma ma ma hūm̐ bh+yo badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: de rgyab dbyangs gsal spel tshig dgod: dang po'i mtshal dang shu kras byug: de rjes rab gnas tshul bzhin bya: yon tan rten du gtor ma dang : phrin las mthun rdzas tshogs tshad bsham: bdag nyid rdo rje khrag 'thung gi: mdun du ma mo 'khor bcas bskyed: bh+yo: chos dbyings skye ba med pa las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul yum gyi mkha'i: snang srid chos 'byung 'bar ba'i dbus: gnam lcags tsakra rtsibs bzhis mtshan: phyi nang me rlung khrag mtsho 'khyil: lte bar pad nyi bam ro'i steng : dus gsum bde gshegs thugs kyi yum: sngags srung chen mo ral gcig ma: mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: spyan dang tshems dang mche ba gcig: nyag gcig ral pa mkha' la sgreng : phyag g.yas zhing dbyug klad la 'phyar: g.yon pas nyams pa'i tsit+ta za: rab khros lcags spyang pho nyar 'gyed: ye shes me phung cher 'khrugs klong : rang 'dra'i sprul pa 'bum dang bcas: zhabs zung dor stabs 'jigs pas bzhugs: stag sham sprin dkar stod g.yogs gsol: sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan: shar du sku sprul dkar mo 'bum: bzhad cing gtum pa'i tshul du ston:

lho ru yon tan ser mo 'bum: sgeg cing gzi brjid rab tu 'bar: nub tu gsung sprul dmar mo 'bum: shin tu chags pa'i gar thabs sgyur: byang du phrin las ljang mo 'bum: drag shul chen pos rgyug cing 'phyo: gzhan yang las dang 'jig rten gyi: ma mo bsam yas grangs med pa: bdud rtsi gsang ba'i srung ma'i tshogs: nyi zer rdul ltar 'khrigs pa yi: thugs kar nyi steng bh+yo yig dang : rang gi thugs nas 'od 'phros pas: ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs bsam: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bde chen dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : bstan pa bsrung phyir 'bar ba'i tshul: sngags srung chen mo ral gcig ma: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i 'khor dang bcas: dam tshig dbang gis spyan 'dren na: gsang chen bstan pa skyong ba dang : nyams pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phyir: ma thogs myur du da tshur byon: bh+yo ma ma e ka dzā ṭī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ bh+yoḥ dur khrod drag po'i gnas 'di ru: dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs nas kyang : he ru ka dpal rig 'dzin che'i: 'da' ka'i dam tshig gnyer du longs: bh+yo ma ma e ka dzā ṭī sa pa ri wā ra tiṣ+ṭhan+tu: badz+ra sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐: hūm̐: dngos bshams yid kyis rab sprul pa'i: dur khrod drag po'i nyer spyod dang : sman raka gtor tshogs mchod sprin gyis: ma mo 'khor bcas mnyes gyur cig: oṃ shrī e ka dzā ṭī sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe ni wi d+yā shab+da sarba pū dza hoḥ ma hā a mṛ ta khā hiḥ ma hā rak+ta khā hiḥ bh+yo ma ma e ka dzā ṭī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: hūm̐ bh+yo: gzung 'dzin kun rtog ral pa'i tshogs: nyag gcig skye ba med par sbreng : srid zhi kun la khyab pa'i bdag: dbyings kyi ma mor phyag 'tshal bstod: ma ni myang 'das yum gyi mkha': mo ni 'khor ba skyed pa'i klong :

dbyer med dbyings las cir yang ston: ye shes ma mor phyag 'tshal bstod: zhi ba'i thabs kyis gdul dka' bar: khro 'khrugs rnam 'gyur mi bzad 'bar: 'jig rten las kyi ma mo'i tshogs: 'bum phrag 'khor bcas kun la bstod: mdun bskyed thugs kar nyi ma'i steng : bh+yo yig srog gi sngags kyis mtshan: bdag nyid rdo rje khrag 'thung gi: thugs srog 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis: rab tu bskul zhing drwa bas bcings: chags dang rngams pa'i stobs bskyed pas: ma mo 'khor bcas dam la gzir: gang 'dod las kun sgrub par bsam: bh+yo ma ma e ka dzā ṭī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: 'bum phrag gsum gyis las kun byed: sngags sham las bzhi'i spel tshig sbyar: sarba ro ga shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: sarba ā yur puṇ+ye puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ: sarba lo ka wā shaṃ ma na ya ho: sarba sha trūn mā ra ya phaṭa: drag po'i las la rbad pa na: dgra bgegs dgug bsgral zhal du bstab: bh+yo ma ma rak+ṣa sī ru lu ru lu ma hiṃ bh+yo: sarba sha trūn ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha bhin+dha bhin+dha mā ra ya phaṭa: ces bzlas bskul bya thun gtor 'phang : bdun brgyud rtsad nas gcod par 'gyur: dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi'i sngags kyi srung ma'i sgrub thabs kyi rim pa ste dang po'o: sa ma ya: thun mtshams thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir: dam rdzas 'dod yon sprin du brlab: thod rnga brdung zhing rkang gling 'bud: dar nag g.yab cing gzi byin bskyed: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dur khrod drag shul chen po'i zhing : snod bcud 'bar ba e yi klong : thod pa'i sku mkhar brjid dang ldan: mi ro rta ro gcal du bkram: sha sna snying sna'i rgyal mtshan phyar: rak+ta 'bar ba'i rba klong 'khrugs: rngams brjid chen po'i mchod sprin gyis: bdud rtsi gsang ba'i gnyer 'dzin pa'i: sngags srung 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung bshags: ma mo 'khrugs pa zhi bar mdzod: nad yams mtshon 'khrugs bar chad sol:

snod bcud rgud pa dbyings su stims: dpal 'byor longs spyod tshe g.yang spel: rlung sems snang ba dbang du sdus: log lta'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: gsang chen bstan pa dar ba dang : 'gro kun bde ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nyams pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba yi: dbang po'i me tog tshil gsur spos: zhun chen mar me mkhris pa'i dri: sha rus zhal zas rkang gling dung : 'jigs rungs gzugs dang rngams pa'i sgra: mi sdug dri dang bcud chen ro: khrag 'dzag pags pa'i gos la sogs: dur khrod rdzas kyi mchod sprin gyis: bdud rtsi gsang ba'i gnyer 'dzin pa'i: sngags srung 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung bshags: ma mo 'khrugs pa zhi bar mdzod: nad yams mtshon 'khrugs bar chad sol: snod bcud rgud pa dbyings su stims: dpal 'byor longs spyaud tshe g.yang spel: rlung sems snang ba dbang du sdus: log lta'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: gsang chen bstan pa dar ba dang : 'gro kun bde ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: lcags kyu lnga dang sgron ma lnga: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ba'i: bdud rtsi sman phud mtsho ltar bskyil: 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i gter chen po'i: dpal gyi gtor ma lhun por spungs: khams gsum gdug pa bsgral ba yi: rak+ta'i zham chu char bzhin 'bebs: rmad du byung ba'i mchod sprin 'dis: bdud rtsi gsang ba'i gnyer 'dzin pa'i: sngags srung 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung bshags: ma mo 'khrugs pa zhi bar mdzod: nad yams mtshon 'khrugs bar chad sol: snod bcud rgud pa dbyings su stims: dpal 'byor longs spyod tshe g.yang spel: rlung sems snang ba dbang du sdus: log lta'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: gsang chen bstan pa dar ba dang : 'gro kun bde ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ sku dang sngags byang 'khor lo sogs: ma mo'i srog gi rten du bcas: yon tan gtor chen brjid dang ldan:

phrin las mthun rdzas skar ltar bkra: zhing lpags bla bre mkha' la bres: don snod drwa bas bar snang khyab: 'dod yon tshogs kyi longs spyod sogs: mthun pa'i rdzas kyi mchod sprin 'dis: bdud rtsi gsang ba'i gnyer 'dzin pa'i: sngags srung 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung bshags: ma mo 'khrugs pa'i zhi bar mdzod: nad yams mtshon 'khrugs bar chad sol: snod bcud rgud pa dbyings su stims: dpal 'byor longs spyod tshe g.yang spel: rlung sems snang ba dbang du sdus: log lta'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: gsang chen bstan pa dar ba dang : 'gro kun bde ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ ma ni ngo bo stong pa'i dbyings: mo ni rang bzhin gsal khyab shar: gnyis med thugs rje'i 'du 'phro las: rtog 'dul dam tshig ji snyed pa'i: rnam 'gyur 'gag pa med pa'i rtsal: cir yang 'char zhing 'byung ba kun: thig le chen po gcig tu brdal: bla na med pa'i mchod sprin 'dis: bdud rtsi gsang ba'i gnyer 'dzin pa'i: sngags srung 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung bshags: ma mo 'khrugs pa zhi bar mdzod: nad yams mtshon 'khrugs bar chad sol: snod bcud rgud pa dbyings su stims: dpal 'byor longs spyod tshe g.yang spel: rlung sems snang ba dbang du sdus: log lta'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: gsang chen bstan pa dar ba dang : 'gro kun bde ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces brjod yi ge brgya pa bzla: dam skong phrin las dngos grub 'gyur: ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pa las: phyi nang bar chad mang du 'byung : de phyir khyad par skong ba ni: ma da na yi sgo nas bsgrub: rin chen bdud rtsi mā ma kīs: legs par sbyar ba'i phud kyi mchog: tshe dang gal du mthun bsdebs nas: ri rab chos 'byung bcas pa'i steng : dpal gtor brjid ldan 'khor bzhi dang : theb kyus bskor zhing rgyan gyis brgyan: dar gyi gur phub nam mkha' dang :

rgyang bu shing ris mda' 'phang gzug: bang rim rnams su srog chags mdangs: 'bur ram ris su gtod pa dang : gzhan yang mthun rdzas dkor cha'i tshogs: ji ltar 'byor pas mtha' bskor nas: rten gyi mdun du mdzes par bsham: de mdun phud kyi thod pa dang : g.yas su bzang shing phur mar bsregs: g.yon du ku sha'i chun pos 'thor: sngags dang phyag rgya drug gis brlab: de nas so sor smreng gis bskang : hūm̐ bh+yo: rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che: rin chen mā ma kī dang sbyor: byang chub sems kyi sprin chen po: rā sa yā na'i bcud du bskyil: tshe dang gal gyis mthun bsdebs par: rat+na 'bru sman spod kyis bran: dpal gyi gtor ma brjid dang ldan: ri rab chos 'byung 'bar ba'i dbus: 'dod yon rnam pa thams cad pa'i: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por rdzogs: dbyings kyi nam mkha' 'od lngar 'bar: ye shes rgyang bu sku gsung thugs: thabs shes las kyi mda' 'phang dang : 'jig rten mig sgyur shing ris bkra: dgos 'byung rin chen nad sel sman: srog chags mdangs dang dkor nor dbyig: bza' bca' btung ba'i longs spyod sogs: gang bzhed mthun rdzas sprin ltar gtibs: 'dod 'byung dpal gyi dam tshig 'dis: dbyings kyi ma mor mnyes mchod 'bul: ye shes ma mo'i thugs dam bskang : las kyi ma mo dgyes rgur rol: 'jig rten ma mo tshim par spyod: bdag cag dam tshig nyams chag dang : dus ngan sems can 'khrul pa yis: thugs dang 'gal ba'i las bgyis pa: snying nas bshags so tshangs par stsol: thugs rje khros pa zhi bar mdzod: dam dang 'gal ba bzod par bzhes: khong nas 'khrugs pa dbyings su stims: rngams pa'i brtul zhugs bgegs la phob: khyad par nyon mongs nga rgyal dang : 'byung ba sa las gyur pa yi: ma mo 'khrugs pa'i rgyu rkyen dang : nad mtshon dus 'khrugs 'bras bu'i tshogs: mkha' la sprin ltar dag nas kyang : zhi dang bkra shis bde legs stsol:

bh+yo ma ma e ka dzā ṭī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: lam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe a a swā hā: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che: rin chen mā ma kī dang sbyor: byang chub sems kyi sprin chen pos: rā sa yā na'i bcud du bskyil: gtsang ma'i phud dang mthun bsdebs par: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ba'i: bdud rtsi chen pos rab tu bran: yid bzhin mtshan ldan ka pā lar: rgya mtsho bzhin du 'khyil pa las: 'dod rgu'i rba rlabs mkha' la 'phro: kha dog dri dang ro ldan cing : nus pa phun sum tshogs pa yi: bde chen bcud kyi dam tshig 'dis: dbyings kyi ma mor mnyes mchod 'bul: ye shes ma mo'i thugs dam bskang : las kyi ma mo dgyes rgur rol: 'jig rten ma mo tshim par spyod: bdag cag dam tshig nyams chag dang : dus ngan sems can 'khrul pa yis: thugs dang 'gal ba'i las bgyis pa: snying nas bshags so tshangs par stsol: thugs rje khros pa zhi bar mdzod: dam dang 'gal ba bzod par bzhes: khong nas 'khrugs pa dbyings su stims: rngams pa'i brtul zhugs bgegs la phob: khyad par nyon mongs 'dod chags dang : 'byung ba chu las gyur pa yi: ma mo 'khrugs pa'i rgyu rkyen dang : nad mtshon dus 'khrugs 'bras bu'i tshogs: mkha' la sprin ltar dag nas kyang : zhi dang bkra shis bde legs stsol: bh+yo ma ma e ka dzā ṭī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐:bam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe a a swā hā: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che: rin chen mā ma kī dang sbyor: byang chub sems kyi sprin chen pos: rā sa ya na'i bcud du bskyil: 'bar ba'i me dang mthun bsdebs par: bzang shing sna tshogs dri dang sbyar: bza' btung 'bru sman phur mas bran: gtsang zhing yid 'phrog dud sprin gyis: 'jig rten khams kun yongs khyab pas: grib dang mi gtsang thams cad sel: dbang yul zag med bde chen skyed: 'dod pa'i longs spyod char 'bebs pa'i:

ngo mtshar chen po'i mchod sprin 'dis: dbyings kyi ma mo mnyes mchod 'bul: ye shes ma mo'i thugs dam bskang : las kyi ma mo dgyes rgur rol: 'jig rten ma mo tshim par spyod: bdag cag dam tshig nyams chag dang : dus ngan sems can 'khrul pa yis: thugs dang 'gal ba'i las bgyis pa: snying nas bshags so tshangs par stsol: thugs rje khros pa zhi bar mdzod: dam dang 'gal ba bzod par bzhes: khong nas 'khrugs pa dbyings su stims: rngams pa'i brtul zhugs bgegs la phob: khyad par nyon mongs zhe sdang dang : 'byung ba me las gyur pa yi: ma mo 'khrugs pa'i rgyu rkyen dang : nad mtshon dus 'khrugs 'bras bu'i tshogs: mkha' la sprin ltar dag nas kyang : zhi dang bkra shis bde legs stsol: bh+yo ma ma e ka dzā ṭī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: ram̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe a a swā hā: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che: rin chen mā ma kī dang sbyor: byang chub sems kyi sprin chen pos: rā sa yā na'i bcud du bskyil: g.yo ba'i rlung dang mthun bsdebs nas: dag byed rtswa yis phyogs bcur gtor: lha la phog na dgyes pa bskyed: mched la phog na nyams chag sbyong : snod la phog na byin 'od chags: bcud la phog na nus stobs 'bar: rdzas la phog na 'dod rgur spel: bgegs la phog na rgyang du bros: cir yang 'char zhing 'byung ba yi: mig 'phrul lta bu'i dam tshig 'dis: dbyings kyi ma mor mnyes mchod 'bul: ye shes ma mo'i thugs dam bskang : las kyi ma mo dgyes rgur rol: 'jig rten ma mo tshim par spyod: bdag cag dam tshig nyams chag dang : dus ngan sems can 'khrul pa yis: thugs dang 'gal ba'i las bgyis pa: snying nas bshags so tshangs par stsol: thugs rje khros pa zhi bar mdzod: dam dang 'gal ba bzod par bzhes: khong nas 'khrugs pa dbyings su stims: rngams pa'i brtul zhugs bgegs la phob: khyad par nyon mongs phrag dog dang :

'byung ba rlung las gyur pa yi: ma mo 'khrugs pa'i rgyu rkyen dang : nad mtshon dus 'khrugs 'bras bu'i tshogs: mkha' la sprin ltar dag nas kyang : zhi dang bkra shis bde legs stsol: bh+yo ma ma e ka dzā ṭī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: yam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe a a swā hā: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba che: rin chen mā ma kī dang sbyor: byang chub sems kyi sprin chen pos: rwa sa yā na'i bcud du bskyil: chos kyi dbyings dang mthun bsdebs nas: rnam rtog thams cad sems su bcad: sems nyid skye med gnyug mar shes: rang bzhin yongs shes 'od gsal dang : rtsal dang rol pa cir yang 'phro: snang grags thams cad lha dang sngags: rtog pa'i drwa ba dbyings kyi rgyan: dbyings rig zung 'jug 'dod rgu'i gter: nam mkha' mdzod du yongs shar ba'i: bla na med pa'i dam tshig 'dis: dbyings kyi ma mor mnyes mchod 'bul: ye shes ma mo'i thugs dam bskang : las kyi ma mo dgyes rgur rol: 'jig rten ma mo tshim par spyod: bdag cag dam tshig nyams chag dang : dus ngan sems can 'khrul pa yis: thugs dang 'gal ba'i las bgyis pa: snying nas bshags so tshangs par stsol: thugs rje khros pa zhi bar mdzod: dam dang 'gal ba bzod par bzhes: khong nas 'khrugs pa dbyings su stims: rngams pa'i brtul zhugs bgegs la phob: khyad par nyon mongs gti mug dang : 'byung ba nam mkha' las gyur pa'i: ma mo 'khrug pa'i rgyu rkyen dang : nad mtshon dus 'khrugs 'bras bu'i tshogs: mkha' la sprin ltar dag nas kyang : zhi dang bkra shis bde legs stsol: bh+yo ma ma e ka dzā ṭī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe a a swā hā: zhes brjod dam tshig rdzas kun gyi: rten 'brel brda la nges shes bskyed: don gyi de nyid dran byas la: dbyings rig dbyer med dgongs pa bskyang : 'dis ni ma mo 'khrugs pa yi: rgyu 'bras skad cig yud la zhi:

srung ma lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs: dngos grub mtsho ltar rgyas par 'gyur: de nas phrin las gsol ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dbyings kyi yum mchog kun tu bzung : ye shes sngags srung ral gcig ma: 'jig rten las kyi ma mo'i ste: bdud rtsi gsang ba'i srung ma ni: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i 'khor tshogs kun: sngon tshe he ru ka dpal dang : rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i spyan snga ru: ji ltar zhal bzhes dam bcas ltar: sman gtor rak+ta'i mchod pa dang : myos byed bdud rtsi'i skyems phud bzhes: dgyes pa'i phrin las shugs phyung la: gsang chen rdo rje'i bstan pa srungs: bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i phrin las sgrubs: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: nad gdod bar chad zhi bar mdzod: tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes spel: snod bcud legs tshogs dbang du sdus: bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba yi: dgra dpung thal ba'i rdul du rlog: bgegs dpung bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: byad phur rbod gtong than ltas zlog: phyi nang 'byung ba 'khrugs pa yi: rgud pa thams cad dbyings su sol: bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas pa dang : 'jig rten bde ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces brjod phud dang gtor ma gshegs: des ni bar chad kun zhi zhing : 'dod pa'i don rnams myur 'grub byed: gzhan yang sngon gyi srung ma la: gtor ma sbyin zhing tha tshig bsgrag: las kyi gnyer yang gtad par bya: hūm̐ bh+yo: sngon tshe 'og min bde chen zhing : gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na: bcom ldan rdo rje he ru kas: tha tshig phog pa'i srung ma kun: 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma bzhes: rnam bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bar du lha min 'du ba'i gnas: a su ra yi brag phug tu: slob dpon bde ba chen po yis: dam la bzhag pa'i dregs tshogs kun: 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma bzhes: rnam bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ da lta sgrub pa'i gnas mchog 'dir:

gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: 'bod cing bskul ba'i srung ma kun: 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma bzhes: rnam bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: shrī badz+ra dharma pā la sarba sa ma ya karma ku ru ho: bshal chu'i bdud rtsis brtan ma mchod: hūm̐ bh+yo: a su ra yi brag phug tu: slob dpon bde ba chen po dang : rigs ldan shākya de wī yis: rdo rje bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor du: gsang ba'i dam tshig gnyer gtad pa'i: brtan ma skyong ma ya ma'i tshogs: sman phran 'bum gyi 'khor dang bcas: tshur gshegs bshal chu'i bdud rtsi bzhes: bod khams so kha srung ba dang : mtha' dmag gdug pa'i 'tshe ba zlog: nad mug 'khrugs rtsod dal yams sol: legs tshogs rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: ma ma ḍā ki nī sarba sa ma ya a mṛ ta pū dza hoḥ zhes gsol bshal chu gtsang sar dor: mtha' rgyas gtor ma bskyang ba'o: dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi'i sngags kyi srung ma'i mchod skong gi rim pa ste gnyis pa'o: sa ma ya: srog gtad zab mo'i man ngag ni: dam tshig ldan pa'i snying gi bus: drag po'i rdzas dang maṇ+ḍal phul: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang : nyams pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phyir: bdud rtsi gsang ba'i srung ma yi: srog gtad rjes gnang stsal du gsol: zhes gsol dam tshig bdud rtsi sbyin: sngags srung ma mo 'bum sdai yi: srog gi ye shes khyod la sbyin: dam las 'das na gshed du 'gyur: de phyir rdo rje'i dam tshig srungs: sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu: zhes gdams des kyang tha tshig 'dor: sa ma ya badz+ra rak+sha sī na ra kan: de nas rgyud sbyang he ru kar: bskyed cing ye shes brtan byas la: sku yi phyag rgya gtad pa'i phyir: gtor ma lhar gsal lag tu bzhag: bh+yo: sngags srung ma mo 'bum sde'i tshogs: dam ldan rdo rje slob ma 'di'i: lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs nas kyang : rnam bzhi'i phrin las sgrub par gyis:

sngags mthar: kā ya badz+ra sa ma ya staṃ: sku las sku 'phros he ru ka'i: thugs srog gdan la thim par bsam: gsung gi rig pa gtad pa'i phyir: bzlas pa'i lung sbyin sngags byang gtad: bh+yo: ma mo'i srog gi snying po 'di: gnyen po stobs dang ldan par zlos: mchod bstod sgrub la brtson par gyis: dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub par 'gyur: wā ka badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: thugs kyi de nyid ngo sprod phyir: gtor ma'i lha tshogs gnyis med bstim: tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: dbyings rigs zung 'jug ngang du bzhag: khyad par man ngag sbyin par bya: bh+yo: 'jig rten ma mo rtsa yin te: 'khor lo rnam bzhi dbu mar gzhug: las kyi ma mo rlung yin te: sbyor ba bzhi yis rab tu gcun: ye shes ma mo thig le ste: dga' ba bzhi yi dbyings su stims: dbyings kyi ma mo sems yin te: stong pa bzhi yi ye shes bskyed: stong srog rang rig chos skur bcad: don gyi ma mo 'grub par 'gyur: dzñā na bhā tu a aḥ bdud rtsi gsang ba'i srung ma che: sngags kyi gnyer 'dzin ral gcig ma'i: srog gi rim pa 'di gtad pas: ma mo nam yang mi 'bral 'grogs: dam tshig gzhung bzhin spyod pa la: dngos grub thams cad 'bad med ster: dam las 'gal na gshed du 'bebs: de phyir dam tshig mchog tu gces: dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi'i sngags kyi srung ma'i srog gtad zab mo'i rim pa ste gsum pa'o: sa ma ya: bdud rtsi gsang ba'i srung ma che'i: sgrub thabs rim pa gsum pa 'di: o rgyan mkhan po'i gsung bzhin du: lo tsā bdag gis yi ger bris: ma 'ongs don du gter du sbas: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang : rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i dpal du shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: rgya rgya rgya: gu h+ya sa ma ya:
